targets.approach: In winter the road beyond the last plowed stretch is a long ski or walk to the Granite Lake trailhead, and the trail then follows Granite Creek up to Granite Lake, so plan a long approach or an overnight camp at the lake. The start is on the snow slopes between the first and second tiers on the far right. Either climb the first pitch of Tomorrow Land and walk right to the next step, or walk up the main gully around the lower rock cliff.
targets.descent_text: Rappel the route using trees or V-threads.
targets.name: Devil's Brownies

targets.approach: In winter the road beyond the last plowed stretch is a long ski or walk to the Granite Lake trailhead, and the trail then follows Granite Creek up to Granite Lake, so plan a long approach or an overnight camp at the lake. Cross the lake toward the wall, work up the left side, and traverse over at the level of the second tier. The Three Tiers sit across the gully from the Thunderdome. The route is in the middle of the second tier, just right of Splendid Angharad.
targets.name: Furiosa

targets.approach: In winter the road beyond the last plowed stretch is a long ski or walk to the Granite Lake trailhead, and the trail then follows Granite Creek up to Granite Lake, so plan a long approach or an overnight camp at the lake. Cross the lake toward the wall and work up the left side. To reach the third tier, either hike up and around the end of the second tier, or climb a second-tier route and walk up from its top. The route starts just right of the house-sized boulder and follows the obvious ice flow.
targets.descent_text: Rappel the route from V-threads, or continue up to a tree at almost a rope length.
targets.name: Grease Rat

targets.approach: In winter the road beyond the last plowed stretch is a long ski or walk to the Granite Lake trailhead, and the trail then follows Granite Creek up to Granite Lake, so plan a long approach or an overnight camp at the lake. Cross the lake toward the wall and work up the left side. To reach the third tier, either hike up and around the end of the second tier, or climb a second-tier route and walk up from its top. Look for the main flow of ice on the third tier; this line takes the far left option of steep ice.
targets.descent_text: Rappel the route from V-threads, or walk off.
targets.name: Gyro Captain

targets.approach: In winter the road beyond the last plowed stretch is a long ski or walk to the Granite Lake trailhead, and the trail then follows Granite Creek up to Granite Lake, so plan a long approach or an overnight camp at the lake. Cross the lake toward the wall and work up the left side. To reach the third tier, either hike up and around the end of the second tier, or climb a second-tier route and walk up from its top. It sits in the middle of the third tier, a couple of hundred feet right of the house-sized boulder and Grease Rat.
targets.descent_text: The route is best rappelled from a V-thread before you top out. You can also top out and walk over to nearby trees.
targets.name: Max's Bloodline

targets.approach: In winter the road beyond the last plowed stretch is a long ski or walk to the Granite Lake trailhead, and the trail then follows Granite Creek up to Granite Lake, so plan a long approach or an overnight camp at the lake. Cross the lake toward the wall and work up the left side. To reach the third tier, either hike up and around the end of the second tier, or climb a second-tier route and walk up from its top. The route is on the far left of the third tier.
targets.descent_text: The easiest way down is to walk off to skier's right from the top.
targets.name: Mystery Gas

targets.approach: In winter the road beyond the last plowed stretch is a long ski or walk to the Granite Lake trailhead, and the trail then follows Granite Creek up to Granite Lake, so plan a long approach or an overnight camp at the lake. Cross the lake toward the wall and work up the left side. To reach the third tier, either hike up and around the end of the second tier, or climb a second-tier route and walk up from its top. Find the large flow in the middle of the third tier. The route is just right of it and starts in a chimney behind a house-sized boulder.
targets.name: Peaple Eater

targets.approach: In winter the road beyond the last plowed stretch is a long ski or walk to the Granite Lake trailhead, and the trail then follows Granite Creek up to Granite Lake, so plan a long approach or an overnight camp at the lake. Cross the lake toward the wall and work up the left side. To reach the third tier, either hike up and around the end of the second tier, or climb a second-tier route and walk up from its top. It is at the left end of the third tier, about 100 feet left of the big flow of Gyro Captain.
targets.descent_text: From the small tree at the top, rappel or walk off to skier's right.
targets.name: Pig Killer

targets.approach: In winter the road beyond the last plowed stretch is a long ski or walk to the Granite Lake trailhead, and the trail then follows Granite Creek up to Granite Lake, so plan a long approach or an overnight camp at the lake. Cross the lake toward the wall and work up the left side. To reach the third tier, either hike up and around the end of the second tier, or climb a second-tier route and walk up from its top. Look for three bolts on a small arete about 20 feet right of Grease Rat, usually under a large hanging dagger of ice.
targets.name: Sarcophagus of Lies

targets.approach: In winter the road beyond the last plowed stretch is a long ski or walk to the Granite Lake trailhead, and the trail then follows Granite Creek up to Granite Lake, so plan a long approach or an overnight camp at the lake. Cross the lake and hike up the main gully between the Three Tiers and the Thunderdome to the base of the route. It is the last bit of ice on the tiers before the central gully, on the left side, to the right of Tomorrow Land.
targets.descent_text: Rappel into the main gully, or hike over to the rappel trees used for Tomorrow Land.
targets.name: Scales of Justice

targets.approach: In winter the road beyond the last plowed stretch is a long ski or walk to the Granite Lake trailhead, and the trail then follows Granite Creek up to Granite Lake, so plan a long approach or an overnight camp at the lake. Cross the lake toward the wall, work up the left side, and traverse over at the level of the second tier. The Three Tiers sit across the gully from the Thunderdome. It is the steepest ice in the center of the second tier, just left of an obvious rock arete and right of Capable.
targets.descent_text: Rappel from V-threads or from trees.
targets.name: Spledid Angharad

targets.approach: In winter the road beyond the last plowed stretch is a long ski or walk to the Granite Lake trailhead, and the trail then follows Granite Creek up to Granite Lake, so plan a long approach or an overnight camp at the lake. Cross the lake toward the wall, work up the left side, and traverse over at the level of the second tier. The Three Tiers sit across the gully from the Thunderdome. The route is the large left-facing corner at the right end of the second tier.
targets.descent_text: A good rappel tree stands up and to the right of the top of the route.
targets.name: The Dag

targets.approach: In winter the road beyond the last plowed stretch is a long ski or walk to the Granite Lake trailhead, and the trail then follows Granite Creek up to Granite Lake, so plan a long approach or an overnight camp at the lake. Cross the lake toward the wall, work up the left side, and traverse over at the level of the second tier. The Three Tiers sit across the gully from the Thunderdome. Look for the lower-angle cliff with ice pouring over it near the middle of the second tier, halfway between Toast and Splendid Angharad.
targets.name: The Wasteland

targets.approach: In winter the road beyond the last plowed stretch is a long ski or walk to the Granite Lake trailhead, and the trail then follows Granite Creek up to Granite Lake, so plan a long approach or an overnight camp at the lake. Cross the lake toward the wall, work up the left side, and traverse over at the level of the second tier. The Three Tiers sit across the gully from the Thunderdome. It is the flow one over to the right of The Dag, at the far right end of the second tier.
targets.descent_text: A good rappel tree stands at the top.
targets.name: The Wretched

targets.approach: In winter the road beyond the last plowed stretch is a long ski or walk to the Granite Lake trailhead, and the trail then follows Granite Creek up to Granite Lake, so plan a long approach or an overnight camp at the lake. Cross the lake toward the wall, work up the left side, and traverse over at the level of the second tier. The Three Tiers sit across the gully from the Thunderdome. The route is about 100 feet right of Toast on the second tier.
targets.name: Toecutter

targets.approach: In winter the road beyond the last plowed stretch is a long ski or walk to the Granite Lake trailhead, and the trail then follows Granite Creek up to Granite Lake, so plan a long approach or an overnight camp at the lake. Cross the lake toward the wall and go up the main gully between the Three Tiers and the Thunderdome. The route follows the largest piece of ice coming down through the first tier, on the left side of the main gully.
targets.descent_text: Once above the last steep wall you can walk up the snow slope for about 100 feet to the last step of ice, or just rappel the route.
targets.name: Tomorrow Land
